title: CBDT Extends Registration Deadline for Valuers and Tax Practitioners to March 31, 2027
content:
# CBDT Extends Registration Deadline for Valuers and Tax Practitioners to March 31, 2027

Ek important update hai for all valuers and authorised income-tax practitioners! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne ek crucial announcement kiya hai regarding the extension of the registration deadline.

This extension provides much-needed relief and additional time for professionals to complete their registration formalities under the new framework.

*   **Old Due Date:** The earlier deadline for registration was September 30, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** The deadline has now been extended to **March 31, 2027**.
*   **Notification Details:** This extension is notified vide **Notification No. 120/2026 dated September 17, 2026**, titled "Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026".
*   The notification also brings changes to Forms 169 (for valuers) and 171 (for authorised income-tax practitioners).
